                      records

    merge             Find and merge duplicate issues

    prime             Print LLM instructions for issue tracking                 
    validate          Validate issue dependencies for cycles                    
    commit            Commit fleece changes to git                              
    dependency        Add or remove parent-child dependency between issues      
    move <ID>         Move an issue up or down among its siblings               
    next              Find issues that can be worked on next based on           
                      dependencies and execution mode                           
    config            View and modify Fleece configuration settings             
    open <IDs>        Set issue status to open                                  
    progress <IDs>    Set issue status to progress                              
    review <IDs>      Set issue status to review                                
    complete <IDs>    Set issue status to complete                              
    archived <IDs>    Set issue status to archived                              
    closed <IDs>      Set issue status to closed

DESCRIPTION:
Create a new issue. --title and --type are required.

USAGE:
    fleece create [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    fleece create --title Fix login bug --type bug -p 1

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                       Prints help information                    
    -v, --version                    Prints version information                 
    -i, --issues <FILE>              Path to a JSONL issues file to use instead 
                                     of the default .fleece/issues_*.jsonl      
    -t, --title <TITLE>              Issue title (required)                     
    -y, --type <TYPE>                Issue type: task, bug, chore, feature,     
                                     idea, verify (required)                    
    -d, --description <DESC>         Issue description                          
    -s, --status <STATUS>            Initial status (default: open)             
    -p, --priority <PRIORITY>        Priority 1-5 (1=highest)                   
        --linked-issues <ISSUES>     Comma-separated linked issue IDs           
        --linked-pr <PR>             Link a pull request number (stored as      
                                     hsp-linked-pr keyed tag)                   
        --parent-issues <ISSUES>     Comma-separated parent issue IDs with      
                                     optional sort order (e.g.,                 
                                     abc123,def456:bbb)                         
    -a, --assign <USER>              Username to assign the issue to            
        --tags <TAGS>                Comma-separated tags (no whitespace allowed
                                     in tags)                                   
    -b, --working-branch <BRANCH>    Working branch ID (valid Git branch name   
                                     characters only)                           
    -e, --execution-mode <MODE>      Execution mode for child issues: series    
                                     (default), parallel                        
        --json                       Output as JSON                             
        --json-verbose               Output as JSON with all metadata fields    
        --commit                     Commit changes to git after creating issue 
        --push                       Push to remote after committing (implies   
                                     --commit)

DESCRIPTION:
List issues with optional filters

USAGE:
    fleece list [ID] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    fleece list --status open --type bug
    fleece list --tree
    fleece list --tree --tree-root abc123
    fleece list --next

ARGUMENTS:
    [ID]    Optional issue ID to show with its hierarchy (parents and children)

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                    Prints help information                       
    -v, --version                 Prints version information                    
    -i, --issues <FILE>           Path to a JSONL issues file to use instead of 
                                  the default .fleece/issues_*.jsonl            
        --parents                 When showing a specific issue, only include   
                                  parent issues (not children)                  
        --children                When showing a specific issue, only include   
                                  child issues (not parents)                    
    -s, --status <STATUS>         Filter by status: draft, open, progress,      
                                  review, complete, archived, closed            
    -y, --type <TYPE>             Filter by type: task, bug, chore, feature,    
                                  idea, verify                                  
    -p, --priority <PRIORITY>     Filter by priority                            
        --assigned <USER>         Filter by assignee                            
        --tag <TAG>               Filter by tag. Use 'key' to match all issues  
                                  with that tag key, or 'key=value' for exact   
                                  match. Can specify multiple times             
        --linked-pr <PR>          Filter by linked PR number (checks            
                                  hsp-linked-pr tags)                           
        --search <QUERY>          Search using query syntax (e.g., 'status:open 
                                  type:bug login')                              
        --json                    Output as JSON                                
        --json-verbose            Output as JSON with all metadata fields       
    -a, --all                     Show all issues including all statuses        
        --one-line                Output each issue on a single line: <id>      
                                  <status> <type> <title>                       
        --strict                  Fail with exit code 1 if schema warnings are  
                                  detected                                      
        --sync-status             Show git sync status for each issue (~=synced,
                                  +=committed, *=local)                         
        --tree                    Display issues in a tree view based on        
                                  parent-child relationships                    
        --tree-root <ID>          (Deprecated: Use '<id> --children' instead)   
                                  Scope tree view to descendants of this issue  
                                  ID (implies --tree)                           
        --next                    Display as a bottom-up task graph showing     
                                  approximate task ordering                     
        --me                      Filter to issues assigned to current user     
        --sort <ORDER>            Sort order for root issues in --next mode.    
                                  Comma-separated criteria: created, priority,  
                                  description, title. Append :asc or :desc      
                                  (default: created:asc)                        
        --show-inactive <MODE>    Control visibility of terminal-status issues  
                                  in --next mode: hide (default),               
                                  if-active-children, always
